title: MDF 402 Payment Required response body
description: Describes the JSON body a server emits with a 402 Payment Required response to an Accept: text/markdown request. This schema describes server output; it places no obligation on consumers. Note that `format` is annotation-only in Draft 2020-12 unless the validator registers a format plugin — the accompanying `pattern` on each string field is the load-bearing constraint and is what implementors should rely on.

error.description: Short machine-stable error label, e.g. 'Payment Required'.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. Advisory only; never parse this to extract price.

resource.description: Absolute URL of the resource being priced, including query string. Emitted by the reference server. This is the one field in a 402 a consumer cannot reconstruct once the response is held out of band.

mdf_version.description: MDF version this response conforms to. The reference server currently carries this as the `x-mdf-version` response header rather than a body field; both are valid, and a major or minor form ('1' or '1.0') is accepted.

auth_endpoint.description: Present where payment at this tier issues a bearer credential rather than delivering content immediately.

token_estimate.description: Optional heuristic token estimate. Never authoritative. If present, token_estimate_note MUST also be present.

token_estimate_note.description: Description of the estimation method, e.g. 'chars/4 approximation'.

byteCount.description: A byte length. Bounded to reject implausible values from an untrusted origin.

payment.description: The payment offer for this resource, plus the site-level mechanism needed to act on it. Note that `amount`, `currency` and `chain` are resource-scoped — they describe this offer — while `accepted_chains` and `accepted_currencies` are site-scoped capability. See CONCEPT.md.

endpoint.description: Where payment is submitted or verified. SHOULD be same-origin with the priced resource.

amount.description: Price for this resource as a decimal string, avoiding binary float representation error. Non-negative.

currency.description: Currency or asset symbol for this offer, e.g. USDC, BTC.

chain.description: Settlement network for this offer, e.g. base, ethereum, lightning.

rail.description: Explicit payment rail. Emitted by the reference server, derived from the same branch that selects the payment verifier. Remains optional in this schema: servers omitting it leave a consumer to map `chain` to a rail itself, which is workable today but ambiguous where two rails share a settlement network. A consumer encountering an unrecognised value is expected to decline rather than improvise.

accepted_chains.description: Site-level capability: all settlement networks this site accepts. Not scoped to this resource. Duplicates mechanism declared in /mdf.json, repeated here to save a round trip.

accepted_currencies.description: Site-level capability: all currencies or assets this site accepts. Not scoped to this resource.

recipient.description: Optional rail-specific payee identifier where the endpoint does not resolve it: EVM address for x402, node pubkey or LSP identifier for l402.

session_nonce.description: Opaque value binding a subsequent payment proof to this specific offer.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which this offer is no longer valid. Emitted by the reference server, derived from the same validity window the `session_nonce` is bound to. Consumers that queue or defer a payment should honour it rather than assuming an offer stands indefinitely.

macaroon.description: L402 only. Bearer credential presented alongside the payment preimage.

reduction_pct.description: (1 - markdown_bytes / source_bytes) * 100, one decimal place. May be negative where conversion increases size.
